Figurobot introduces 11-inch FR-NIA with ten face and neck motion axes

The desktop companion emphasizes expression and app customization, while launch and pricing information remains inconsistent.

Humanoids Daily ↗19 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A desktop conversation companion

Figurobot announced FR-NIA on October 19 as an 11-inch, approximately 28 cm, robot. Its silicone face and moving eyes, eyebrows, mouth and neck give conversations a physical expression. The company positions it for desks and bedside tables rather than household chores.

Customizable movement and expression

The website divides ten degrees of freedom into seven for the face and three for the neck. Advertised app functions include real-time control, motion recording, keyframe editing and custom expressions. Long-term memory and relationship-development features remain plans, rather than confirmed delivery capabilities.

Launch terms need careful reading

The press release advertises early-bird prices from $599 and Lite, Pro and Pro Max versions. The website reviewed instead lists an October 20 Kickstarter launch and $699 or $799 reservation prices with $20 or $1 deposits respectively. It explicitly says a deposit does not purchase a robot: the Kickstarter price and shipping are paid later, and no hardware ships at this stage.
